window-2.title: Dirt
window-2.blurb: It's the culture newsletter that treats a Ghibli frame, a dead website and a pop star's tour merch with equal seriousness — exactly your brain, but in essay form.

window-3.title: Classic Vietnamese Plum Soda (Soda Xí Muội)
window-3.blurb: Salty-sour preserved plum drowned in fizz over cracked ice — it's the nostalgic, slightly feral cousin of every polite floral mocktail, and you get to eat the plum at the end like a prize.

window-4.title: Yellowtrace — Home Tours
window-4.blurb: It's a properly indie design journal full of warm, object-crammed homes — vintage lamps, hand-thrown pottery, colour used with nerve — and its Asia-Pacific eye means you'll actually see rooms that feel like they could exist near you.
